sam: Quick Q 1 planning to be in Cape Town for ~8 weeks (2025-06-01 to 2025-07-26) to visit family but keeping NY as homebase. Can I still get WFH stipend + shipping for my standing monitor? Also traveling with my partner and our 4yo  does that affect benefits or anything payroll-related? Do I need to register anywhere or change anything for tax purposes?
nina (People Ops): Short answer: usually fine for an <90 day stay, stipend + equipment shipping OK if you submit a temp-relocation request. Need to open a case so Payroll/Benefits/Legal can confirm. Please DM your dates, address, and what equipment you're taking.
lee (Payroll): 8 weeks is under the common 183-day/residency threshold, but South Africa has some local reporting for foreigners in certain municipalities. Also check visa conditions. Well run a payroll impact check once we have exact dates and whether youre doing any local-contracted work. Dont change homebase in HR until cleared.
ada (Benefits): Traveling with a dependent doesnt automatically change coverage eligibility. If you want your child on company medical, normal enrollment rules apply and we'll need proof of relationship/address. For short trips your US coverage usually remains primary, but out-of-network costs abroad can be different. We can pull the international care phone number for Cape Town.
nina (People Ops): Forms & flow: https://redwood.internal/people-ops/remote-travel -> select "temporary remote". We ask for: dates, exact address, emergency contact, equipment list, and whether youre meeting customers locally. We prorate stipend if your trip crosses a payroll month and can ship equipment via relocation shipping if approved.
travel-bot: relocation-case #R-2017 opened for sam  please upload address, passport country, and equipment list within 48h. Assigned to @nina.
sam: DMd the details: taking laptop + monitor + dock; partner and kid are staying with me; no client meetings, will work US hours. Passport is US. Thanks!
lee (Payroll): Got the details. Ill run a quick payroll/residency check and note any local registration. If anything looks risky (unexpected reporting or PE flags), well contact you before departure.
ada (Benefits): Ill pull the international provider contact and post reimbursement guidance in the case. If you plan to use private care locally, grab pre-authorization where possible.
nina (People Ops): Thanks Sam  Ill update the case with expected stipend proration and a shipping label link by tomorrow. If trip extends beyond 90 days or you start local work, please update ASAP. :thumbsup:
sam: Appreciate it everyone!
